channel.title: Georgia Public Broadcasting - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Georgia Public Broadcasting (gpb.org)

item.title: TV antennas and Super Bowl rehearsals: How prediction market traders seek an edge
item.description: As prediction markets boom, competition is heating up. So traders go the extra mile for a fraction-of-a-second advantage or to sleuth out information nobody else has. It can lead to a huge payday.

item.title: Georgia students recall horror of being shot as father of accused school shooter goes on trial
item.description: Students in Georgia described the terror of a school shooting as prosecutors try to convict the suspect’s father for giving him the gun.

item.title: GPB evening headlines for February 17, 2026
item.description: A Georgia elementary school teacher has been killed in a motor vehicle collision involving a man who was trying to flee ICE. The Georgia trial of Colin Gray entered its second day with minor victims testifying about their physical and mental injuries. The Georgia Supreme Court is siding with challengers to a law that prohibits direct sales of electric vehicles to consumers.

item.title: Georgia Today: ICE agent car crash; Death of Jesse Jackson; Apalachee high school shooting Trial
item.description: On the Feb 17th Edition: A school teacher in Savannah was killed in a car crash that involved a man fleeing from ICE agents; Georgia leaders are mourning the death of The Reverend Jesse Jackson; And Apalachee High School students take the stand in the trial of the school shooter's father.

item.title: Top DHS spokesperson who became a face of Trump immigration policy is leaving
item.description: Tricia McLaughlin has become the public face defending the Trump administration's mass deportation policy and immigration tactics over the past year.

item.title: Longtime civil rights leader the Rev. Jesse Jackson dies at 84
item.description: The Rev. Jesse Jackson was a lifelong civil rights advocate until his death Tuesday at the age of 84.

item.title: The U.S. falters again in figure skating, but the women still have time to make it up
item.description: Alysa Liu finished the night in third place, Isabeau Levito finished in eighth and Amber Glenn is in 13th place after a popped jump. That puts extra pressure on all of them for Thursday's medal event.

item.title: Meet Yolanda the wax truck, Team USA's unsung cross-country ski hero
item.description: Fast skiers require fast skis. They rely on a team of technicians to wax and prep them for each day's conditions. The U.S. cross-country team has a mobile ski shop that is an unsung hero of their success: Yolanda the wax truck.

item.title: U.S. releases new details on alleged secret Chinese nuclear test
item.description: At a event in Washington D.C., A U.S. official said a remote earthquake in 2020 was caused by a Chinese nuclear test.

item.title: The record-breaking cocaine boom — and its deadly fallout
item.description: Cocaine has made a roaring comeback, and it's having some big negative effects in the U.S. and around the world.
